H8310.name: Nebu-sar-sekim
H8310.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8310.short: Nebu-sar-sekim was a high official in Nebuchadnezzar's army when Jerusalem fell.

H8315.name: Saraph
H8315.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8315.brief: Son of Shelah, descendant of Judah
H8315.short: Saraph was a son of Shelah and a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H8304J.name: Seraiah
H8304J.brief: Son of Kenaz; father of Joab
H8304J.short: Seraiah, the son of Kenaz, was the father of Joab, who was the father of the Valley of Craftsmen.

H8304K.name: Seraiah
H8304K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8304K.brief: Son of Asiel, descendant of Simeon
H8304K.short: Seraiah, the son of Asiel, was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon.

H8304H.name: Seraiah
H8304H.desc: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8304H.brief: High priest during the reign of Zedekiah
H8304H.short: Seraiah served as the high priest during the reign of King Zedekiah and was executed by the Babylonians after the fall of Jerusalem.

H8304I.name: Seraiah
H8304I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8304I.brief: Officer under Gedaliah, son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite
H8304I.short: Seraiah, the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, was one of the officers who served under Gedaliah, the governor appointed by the Babylonians after the fall of Jerusalem.

H8304G.name: Seraiah
H8304G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H8304G.brief: David's scribe, also known as Shavsha, Sheva, Sheya, or Shisha
H8304G.short: Seraiah, also known as Shavsha, Sheva, Sheya, or Shisha, served as David's scribe during his reign.

H8304L.name: Seraiah
H8304L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8304L.brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
H8304L.short: Seraiah was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and is mentioned in the lists of returning exiles and priests.

H8304M.name: Seraiah
H8304M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8304M.brief: Son of Azriel, sent to capture Jeremiah and Baruch
H8304M.short: Seraiah, the son of Azriel, was one of the men sent by King Jehoiakim to capture Jeremiah and Baruch.

H8304N.name: Seraiah
H8304N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8304N.brief: Neriah's son, Baruch's brother, accompanied Zedekiah to Babylon
H8304N.short: Seraiah, the son of Neriah and brother of Baruch, accompanied King Zedekiah to Babylon and carried a message from Jeremiah.

H8352.name: Seth
H8352.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H8352.brief: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line
H8352.short: Seth was the third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel, and became the ancestor of the righteous line of humanity.

H8325.name: Sharar
H8325.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H8325.brief: Father of Ahiam, one of David's mighty men
H8325.short: Sharar (or Sachar) was the father of Ahiam, who was one of David's mighty men known for his bravery and military prowess.

H8343.name: Shashai
H8343.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8343.brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
H8343.short: Shashai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

H8349.name: Shashak
H8349.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8349.brief: Benjamite leader and descendant of Elpaal
H8349.short: Shashak, a Benjamite leader, was a descendant of Elpaal and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

H8329.name: Sheresh
H8329.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8329.short: Sheresh, a son of Machir and Maacah, mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh.

H8344.name: Sheshai
H8344.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8344.short: Sheshai, one of the Anakite giants, was defeated by Caleb during the conquest of Canaan.

H8348.name: Sheshan
H8348.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8348.brief: Jerahmeelite whose daughter married his Egyptian servant
H8348.short: Sheshan, a Jerahmeelite who gave his daughter in marriage to his Egyptian servant, Jarha.

H8369.name: Shethar
H8369.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8369.brief: Persian noble in King Ahasuerus's court
H8369.short: Shethar, one of the seven Persian nobles who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence.

H8370.name: Shethar-bozenai
H8370.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8370.brief: Persian official who questioned the Jews' temple rebuilding
H8370.short: Shethar-bozenai, a Persian official who questioned the legitimacy of the Jews' efforts to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

H8390.name: Tarea
H8390.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H8390.brief: Son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth
H8390.short: Tarea, also called Tahrea, was a son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth.

H8301.name: Sarid
H8301.short: Sarid was a border town in the territory allotted to the tribe of Zebulun (<ref="Josh. 19:10, 12">Josh. 19:10, 12</ref>).

H8387.name: Taanath-shiloh
H8387.brief: Landmark on the border of Ephraim's territory
H8387.short: Taanath-shiloh, a landmark on the eastern border of the territory allotted to the tribe of Ephraim (<ref="Josh. 16:6">Josh. 16:6</ref>).

H8396H.name: Tabor
H8396H.brief: Oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophecy
H8396H.short: Tabor, an oak tree near Bethel, mentioned in Samuel's prophetic message to Saul (<ref="1Sam. 10:3">1Sam. 10:3</ref>).

H8396G.name: Tabor Mount
H8396G.brief: Mountain in Israel, site of Deborah and Barak's victory
H8396G.short: Mount Tabor, a mountain in Israel, known for the gathering of Deborah and Barak's forces and their victory over Sisera (<ref="Judg. 4:6, 12, 14">Judg. 4:6, 12, 14</ref>).
